cells.forex: Many brokers offer near round-the-clock trading on weekdays, but activity rises and falls with each [[trading-session]].
cells.stocks: Set by each exchange, often a fixed day session; some offer limited trading before and after it.
cells.penny_stocks: Follow the venue they trade on; trading in an individual stock can also be halted.
cells.commodities: Depends on the product; futures hours are set by the exchange, broker contracts by the broker.
cells.futures: Set by the exchange for each contract, often with daily breaks; activity often shifts to the next month near expiry.

caveat: Hours differ by exchange, broker, product and time zone, and change around holidays. Check the exact schedule; a market can be open yet thin.
